title: Juicy Silky Ukrainian Cheese Pasta
description: A citrusy and silky Ukrainian dish featuring cheddar cheese, this pasta is a show-off recipe that combines flavors and textures in a unique way, with sashimi-cut elements and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped fresh dill to the skillet and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the bowl and toss to combine with the lemon juice mixture.
In the same skillet used for the garlic and dill, add the shredded cheddar cheese and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted and silky.
Add the sour cream to the skillet and stir to combine with the cheese sauce.
Add the cheese sauce to the pasta and toss to combine.
Stir in the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for an additional 2 minutes until heated through.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
